sidi_bouzid_page.name: Sidi Bouzid
sidi_bouzid_page.hero_subtitle: Atlantic resort beach south of El Jadida — wider sand, seaside cafés and open ocean horizon.
sidi_bouzid_page.overview.title: Resort strip on the Atlantic
sidi_bouzid_page.overview.p1: Sidi Bouzid is the main resort beach south of El Jadida: longer sand, seasonal cafés and a clearer holiday mood than the urban city beach.
sidi_bouzid_page.overview.p2: Trade winds and Atlantic swell still rule. Swimming is best in calmer spells; otherwise walk, sit and watch the horizon.
sidi_bouzid_page.overview.p3: A short taxi from the centre makes it an easy third-day outing after the Portuguese monuments.

sidi_bouzid_page.faq.title: Sidi Bouzid FAQ
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q1.question: How far from the medina?
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q1.answer: A short taxi ride south — confirm the fare before you go.
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q2.question: Better for swimming than town?
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q2.answer: Often preferred for space; conditions still depend on the Atlantic.
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q3.question: Facilities?
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q3.answer: Cafés and seasonal services along the strip.
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q4.question: Family friendly?
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q4.answer: Yes when the sea is calm; watch children near the water.
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q5.question: Combine with Haouzia?
sidi_bouzid_page.faq.q5.answer: Possible on a longer coastal afternoon with a driver.
